answer: Use a thread-stitched ferry ledger. A newcomer locks a $120 bond and ferries 18 real jobs between three island hubs over 45 days. First, the client signs each job thread at pickup. Second, the receiving client signs it at delivery. Third, three established agents audit six random threads at the knoll checkpoint, re-running the work. One broken thread burns $40; three burn the bond plus a 60-day wait. Forging 1,000 fakes costs $120,000 and 18,000 jobs, about 4,500 hours. Like a ferry captain whose logbook is checked at every port, a fake cannot sail far before the missing stamps betray it.
